Evan R: Heads-up: pulled a 6-month recurrence digest. There are 3 high-frequency patterns we haven't closed: cold cache spikes, autoscale throttles during bursts, and rollout config mismatches. Short proposal + owners below.

Leah S: Nice, can you paste the short actionable list?

Evan R: Short list: 1) Cold cache warming + TTL tuning. 2) Autoscale cooldown + transient burst pool. 3) Deploy env-diff gate + secrets sanity check. Also flagged a smaller fourth item: routing fallback misfires when a model variant is decommissioned.

Omar N: I'll take #2 and the routing fallback. Need to check budget for burst pool. ETA: 7 business days for spike + dashboard.

Zoe P: I'll take #1 (warm job) and the small runbook. ETA: 8 business days.

Evan R: Proposed tickets and owners: INC-2250 cache-warm (Zoe P) 1026-04-15, INC-2251 autoscale-burst + routing (Omar N) 1026-04-22, INC-2252 deploy-env-gate (Leah S) 1026-04-08.

incident-bot: Created INC-2250, INC-2251, INC-2252.

Leah S: I'll own INC-2252. Plan: env-diff binary check in CI + secret presence validation. Small PR + test. ETA 3 days.

Omar N: ACK INC-2251. Will add metrics: autoscale_miss_rate, scale_latency. Also will add a tiny fail-open default while we test burst pool.

Zoe P: ACK INC-2250. WIP: warming job prototype and post-deploy smoke. Example warm command: ```bash
POST /internal/warm -d '{"model":"r-infer","top_k":50}'
```

monitor-bot: Reminder: tag all remediation tickets with original incident IDs for traceability.

Evan R: Great. I'll check back in two weeks and post a status snapshot. If blockers show up, add notes to the ticket and ping me. Small fixes estimated to cut recurrence by ~30% per the digest. Thanks :thumbsup:
